item.title: I'm sweating
item.description: I have to play WoW: Forever, Football Manager 27 and have to complete the MSQ up to Dawntrail in FFXIV. I feel an overwhelming sense of FOMO, i can't stop playing efficiently. I also have autism, OCD and psychosis if that helps. How do i cope with all this shit?
